title: Evaluate storage methodology (SQLite+JSONL vs GitHub Issues vs plain SQLite vs other)
description: Assess current SQLite + git-tracked JSONL sync model. Candidates: keep as-is, plain local SQLite (no JSONL sync), GitHub Issues as backend, other (e.g. per-issue files, Dolt). Must work well with git worktrees (shared vs per-worktree DB, concurrent writers, merge conflicts, branch-scoped issues).
acceptance_criteria: Comparison matrix covering worktree behavior, offline use, merge/conflict story, multi-machine sync, complexity; recommendation; migration sketch.

title: Disable distribution channels (releases, homebrew, winget, npm, pypi)
description: Fork is personal-use; builds by hand. Disable: release.yml, update-homebrew.yml, test-pypi.yml workflows; mark npm package private; guard manual update-homebrew.sh/update-winget.sh scripts. Keep ci.yml, nightly.yml, deploy-docs.yml.
notes: Workflows moved to .github/workflows-disabled/ (GitHub ignores anything outside .github/workflows) with README explaining how to re-enable: release.yml, update-homebrew.yml, test-pypi.yml. Note test-pypi's repo guard matched plongitudes/beads after the rename, so it was live until now. npm-package/package.json marked private:true (npm refuses to publish). update-homebrew.sh and update-winget.sh guarded with early exit. Kept: ci.yml, nightly.yml, deploy-docs.yml, install.sh/install.ps1 (consumer-side, inert without releases), goreleaser brews section (already commented upstream).

title: Evaluate plugin-oriented backend framework for issue recording
description: Assess moving from beads' own storage to a pluggable backend interface. Candidate backends: GitHub Issues, Obsidian, Jira, SQLite, ShotGrid tickets, Perforce, others. Consider what the core interface must cover (deps, ready-work, status, labels, comments), which features degrade per backend, and whether the existing storage interface is a usable seam.
acceptance_criteria: Proposed backend interface; per-candidate feasibility/feature-gap table; recommendation on whether to pursue; relation to storage decision documented.

title: Remove Gas Town (gt) hooks and workflow files from .claude/
description: Upstream's .claude/settings.json runs gt (Gas Town) on SessionStart, PreCompact, every UserPromptSubmit, and Stop. gt is not installed here, so every hook errors and pollutes Claude Code sessions. Also removing upstream's gt-based handoff command/skill. bd source code gastown references (agent/swarm/routing features, 19 files) are product code and left alone.
notes: Removed tracked .claude/settings.json (gt prime/nudge/mail/costs hooks on all four lifecycle events), .claude/commands/handoff.md, .claude/skills/handoff/SKILL.md. gt not installed -> hooks errored on every prompt. Kept .claude/test-strategy.md (clean). bd source gastown refs (19 files: agent, swarm, gate, routing, etc.) are product features using gastown as example rig names - left alone, removal would be major surgery. Git hooks pre-commit/post-merge are pure bd, clean. NOTE: hook config is snapshotted at session start - restart Claude session for removal to take effect.

title: Docs/website/comments sweep for steveyegge references
description: README, CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, RELEASING, docs/*, website/* (docusaurus config, llms.txt), npm-package docs, code comments linking upstream issues/PRs, types.go example org strings. Leave .beads/issues.jsonl data untouched (issue history, not code).
notes: Decisions: (1) upstream issue/PR deep-links in comments now point at plongitudes and will 404 - issue numbers kept in URLs as breadcrumbs, searchable on upstream if needed. (2) thanks.go and docs/daemon-summary.md contributor attribution kept intentionally (factual credit, not repo references). (3) .beads/issues.jsonl data untouched (issue history). (4) Prose author fields (plugin.json, npm package.json, docusaurus footer, winget, marketplace.json) -> Beads Contributors, matching LICENSE.

title: Identify and plan removal of Gastown-specific features; scan for dead code
description: Find commands, flags, issue types, and code paths that exist mainly for Gastown (e.g. rigs, polecats, convoys, molecules, mayor/witness/refinery roles, agent/event types, --rig/--prefix routing, gates/waits-for). Plan removal and run a dead-code scan (e.g. deadcode/staticcheck) after.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory of Gastown-related surface with remove/keep verdict; removal plan ordered to keep builds green; dead-code report.

title: Point bd doctor update checks at fork
description: doctor/version.go:184 queries api.github.com/repos/steveyegge/beads/releases/latest — nags users onto upstream binaries (confirmed: bd init just reported 'latest: 1.1.2' from upstream). Retarget to plongitudes/beads. Also doctor/claude.go PyPI beads-mcp check (upstream-published package) — review whether to keep. Upgrade hint strings (brew tap, curl install.sh) also in doctor.
notes: Version check now hits api.github.com/repos/plongitudes/beads/releases/latest. Degrades gracefully to 'unable to check for updates' while fork has no releases (verified error path in CheckCLIVersion). PyPI beads-mcp check left as-is: no steveyegge reference, but it tracks upstream's PyPI package - revisit if fork publishes its own MCP package.

title: Evaluate whether the daemon is actually helpful
description: Assess the bd daemon (background sync, RPC server, auto-flush/auto-import) against its cost: stale processes after upgrades, extra failure modes, worktree interactions. Compare --no-daemon / direct mode behavior and performance. Decide: keep, simplify, or remove.
acceptance_criteria: Written recommendation (keep/simplify/remove) with evidence; list of code paths affected; follow-up beads filed for chosen path.

title: Hook installers: remove Gas Town identity hook, unify bd init hooks, build-from-source hints
description: Part A: remove prepare-commit-msg agent-identity feature (GT_* env, gt shell-out, cwd substring matching that silently appends Executed-By/Rig/Role trailers). Part B: bd init delegates to installHooks shim installer (fixes missing sync-branch guard, BEADS_NO_AUTO_STAGE, version markers). Part C: install hints -> go install github.com/plongitudes/beads/cmd/bd@latest; remove dead examples/git-hooks refs; onboard.go session-start claim fixed to bd setup claude.
notes: Part A: deleted runPrepareCommitMsgHook + agentIdentity/detectAgentIdentity/parseAgentIdentity/detectAgentFromPath/getPinnedMolecule (263 lines), removed prepare-commit-msg from install/check lists + help text, deleted template. Kept in uninstallHooks for legacy cleanup. Dispatch case is now silent no-op so stale shims from older bd don't block commits (verified exit=0). Part B: installGitHooks delegates to installHooks shim installer; kept prompt flow; choice 1 sets chain=true WITHOUT pre-renaming (installHooks renames .old itself - double-rename trap avoided). Deleted 270 lines of inline hook builders. Part C: canonical install string is 'go install github.com/plongitudes/beads/cmd/bd@latest' everywhere; deleted stale examples/git-hooks/ dir; doctor URLs to nonexistent issue #615 removed; onboard.go now correctly says bd setup claude (not bd hooks install) does session-start injection. GOTCHA found during work: the steveyegge->plongitudes rename broke gofmt import ordering repo-wide (plongitudes sorts before spf13 where steveyegge sorted after) - 274 files reformatted with gofmt -w. Verified: build/vet/full tests green; smoke-tested bd init (4 shims, chain works, commits clean of trailers).

title: Update fork-protection logic for fork
description: cmd/bd/fork_protection.go checks remotes for steveyegge/beads to exclude .beads/issues.jsonl. Currently no-op on this clone (origin=plongitudes). Retarget to plongitudes/beads plus tests in fork_protection_test.go.
notes: Retargeted to plongitudes/beads. Semantics now inverted correctly: this repo (origin=plongitudes/beads) counts as upstream so issues.jsonl commits are allowed here; forks OF this fork get the exclude protection. fork_protection_test.go fixtures updated by same sweep, tests pass.

title: Rename Go module path to github.com/plongitudes/beads
description: go.mod module line + ~950 import statements across all Go files. Mechanical: sed module path, go mod tidy, build, test. Breaks go-install compat with upstream path (intended).
notes: Module path now github.com/plongitudes/beads (go.mod + ~950 imports via global sed). go build, go vet, full test suite pass. Pre-existing vet warning in internal/rpc (context leak) not from this change. go-install of upstream path no longer applies.

title: Evaluate setup/config commands for outdated Claude assumptions
description: Review bd setup, bd init, bd prime, onboarding/quickstart, generated CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md snippets, hooks installers, and slash-command/plugin assets. Identify instructions that assume older Claude Code behavior (e.g. TodoWrite guidance, forced session-close protocols, hook formats, 'NEVER stop before pushing' style mandates) that may be obsolete or actively inhibit modern Claude. Produce a plan to remove or update them.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory of Claude-facing instructions/commands with keep/update/remove verdict each; plan doc; follow-up beads filed.

title: Retarget release/distribution pipeline to plongitudes
description: goreleaser owner, .github/workflows/release.yml + update-homebrew.yml, scripts/install.sh, install.ps1, update-homebrew.sh, update-winget.sh, npm postinstall.js binary download URLs, npm package.json metadata, winget manifests (SteveYegge.beads -> Plongitudes.beads), default.nix homepage. Note: channels won't function until fork publishes its own releases/tap/npm package.
notes: All release URLs/owners -> plongitudes. Winget manifests renamed SteveYegge.beads.* -> Plongitudes.beads.*, PackageIdentifier=Plongitudes.beads, publisher/author -> Beads Contributors. GOTCHA: no distribution channel is functional until fork publishes its own releases/tap. npm package still named @beads/bd (upstream npm scope) - must rename before publishing to npm.

description: Text bd writes into users' repos/terminals: init_templates.go, setup/aider.go, setup/cursor.go, recipes/template.go, quickstart.go, jira.go, doctor fix-it messages, git hook templates (cmd/bd/templates/hooks/*), claude-plugin/*. Replace steveyegge URLs and install commands.
